segments.thag2.40:1.1: “Ayamiti kappaṭo kappaṭakuro, acchāya atibharitāya [atibhariyāya (sī. ka.), accaṃ bharāya (syā.)];
segments.thag2.40:1.3: Amataghaṭikāyaṃ dhammakaṭamatto [dhammakaṭapatto (syā. ka. aṭṭha.), dhammakaṭamaggo (sī. aṭṭha.)], katapadaṃ jhānāni ocetuṃ.
segments.thag2.40:2.1: “Mā kho tvaṃ kappaṭa pacālesi, mā tvaṃ upakaṇṇamhi tāḷessaṃ;
segments.thag2.40:2.3: Na hi [na vā (ka.)] tvaṃ kappaṭa mattamaññāsi, saṅghamajjhamhi pacalāyamānoti.
segments.thag2.40:3.1: Migasiro sivako ca, upavāno ca paṇḍito;
segments.thag2.40:3.3: Isidinno ca kaccāno, nitako ca mahāvasī;
